create_disparity_smooth_loss: create a DisparitySmoothLoss instance with an opt config containing distance_type and sigma_color_grad parameters
compute_forward_loss: compute the spatial smooth disparity loss by passing images and depth tensors to the forward method
configure_sigma_color_grad: configure the sigma_color_grad option to control edge-preserving weight sensitivity in the disparity smooth loss
set_lambda_disparity_smooth: set the lambda_disparity_smooth option to weight the disparity smooth loss in the total loss computation
review_disparity_gradient_calculation: review the DisparitySmoothLoss forward method to understand how disparity gradients are computed and weighted by image gradients
